Container.Name: kb-embed
Container.Overview: The embedding model server for the knowledge stack: it turns text into vectors for kb-service's search, through kb-litellm. STARTED IN ORDER: after kb-litellm, before kb-service. NETWORK: set Network to kb, the user-defined network the knowledge stack shares, created once by hand before the first start. Docker must preserve user-defined networks across updates (Unraid: Settings > Docker, Preserve user defined networks = Yes), or the container falls back to bridge and kb-litellm can no longer resolve kb-embed. EXPOSURE: none. No host port is published; the only caller is kb-litellm on the kb network. ONE-TIME MODEL PULL: after the first start, run docker exec kb-embed ollama pull qwen3-embedding:0.6b and wait for it to finish. The model store is on the Models path; the pull repeats after a rebuild of that folder. CONFIG: kb-litellm must route the embed model name to http://kb-embed:11434 with the model qwen3-embedding:0.6b. KEEP ALIVE: OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=-1 keeps the model in memory, so an upload never waits for a model load. PARALLEL: OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=2 is the most requests served at once inside the limits below. LIMITS (HOST SETS THESE, NOT THIS TEMPLATE): --cpus=4 --memory=3g --memory-swap=3g on the container. Without them the model can take the whole host's memory. HEALTH: no health check in the template. To check, run docker exec kb-embed ollama list; the model must be listed. IMAGE: pinned by digest; upstream tags move, so an Update is a deliberate change of the digest in this template.
Container.Description: Embedding model server for the knowledge stack (qwen3-embedding:0.6b), reached only through kb-litellm on the kb network. Start after kb-litellm, before kb-service. No port published.

Config.Name: Models
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Ollama's model store. Re-pullable: losing it costs a model download, not data. Set an absolute path on a POOL, e.g. /mnt/<pool>/appdata/kb-embed/models.

Config.Name: OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE
Config.Description: How long a loaded model stays in memory after its last request. -1 keeps it loaded, so an upload never waits for a model load. Upstream's default is 5 minutes.

Config.Name: OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL
Config.Description: Requests served at once. Upstream's default is 1. Keep 2 or lower inside the 3 GB memory limit the Overview gives.
